title: Thewalai Khanet, Ganesha Shrine
geometryBasis: Exact named rectangular OSM shrine outline and the documented lawn orientation towards Bhimarn Prathom.
sectionBasis: Primary records describe the Lopburi-influenced domed concrete canopy and brass ornament, raised platform and original bronze figure. Heights, joints, ornament and portal outlines are estimates.
limitations: The mapped shrine perimeter and west facing axis are retained. Section heights, local footing, access dimensions and canopy curvature are estimated.
Canopy profile, platform ornament and the character of the open portals follow architectural descriptions. Exact sculptural motifs, relief, finish colors and hidden surfaces are inferred.
The small bronze figure is a simplified original rendering from textual identification, materials and facing. Its individual iconographic details are approximate.
The original terrain is used at the mapped lawn and no ground shaping is authored.
